Metadata.title: Tourneasy — Tournament made easy
Metadata.description: Find badminton tournaments, enter online, pay with iDEAL and follow matches and results live.

Home.heroText: Find a tournament, enter singles, doubles or mixed, pay with iDEAL and follow your matches live.
Home.featureFollowText: Get notified when your club mates and favourites play.
Home.aboutTitle: Built by players, for players, clubs and organisers
Home.aboutText: We play badminton ourselves, so we know what a tournament day needs. One platform for the whole day, from entry to final: organisers plan draws and courts, players follow every result live.
Home.featureLiveText: Results reach every phone the moment they are entered.
Home.featurePayText: Pay your entry fee securely; refunds take one click.
Home.featureScheduleText: Match schedules and court plans are proposed for you and can be adjusted by hand.

Profile.title: My profile

mfa.title: Two-step login
mfa.intro: After your password, Tourneasy asks for a code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or 1Password. Nobody can log in with just your password.
mfa.required: As an admin, two-step login is required. Set it up now; then you can use the portal again.
mfa.codesLeft: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left: make new ones.} one {# recovery code left.} other {# recovery codes left.}}
mfa.step1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key in the app:
mfa.step2: 2. Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add Tourneasy to your authenticator app
mfa.recoveryIntro: Keep these codes somewhere safe, for example in your password manager or printed. Lost your phone? Log in with one of these codes; each works once. You only see them now.
mfa.disableHintStaff: Note: as an admin you can only use the portal again after setting it up again, for example on a new phone.
mfa.disableHintPlayer: After that only your password is needed to log in.
mfa.enabled: Two-step login is on. Your other devices were logged out; log in there again with a code.
mfa.recoveryUsed: You logged in with a recovery code. Make new recovery codes, or set up the app again if you lost your phone.

Privacy.title: Privacy and data
Privacy.intro: You have the right to access and delete your data (GDPR).
Privacy.exportText: Download all your data as a JSON file.
Privacy.deleteText: Your personal data will be anonymised and you will be logged out everywhere. Results of matches played are kept anonymously. This cannot be undone.
Privacy.deleteConfirm: I understand that my account will be deleted permanently.
Privacy.deleted: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Tourneasy.

The member number is enough when you know it; otherwise name, gender (M/F) and date of birth, optionally email and club. Players who don't exist yet are created automatically. Columns: {columns}. Full categories go to the waiting list; no emails are sent.

emailSettings.title: Email settings
emailSettings.intro: The mail server (SMTP) for all emails: confirmations, invitations, receipts and password resets.
emailSettings.statusEnvironment: Email is sent with the server settings (environment variables). Settings saved here take precedence.
emailSettings.statusOff: No mail server is set up yet: emails only go to the server log and reach nobody.
emailSettings.unreadable: The stored password can’t be read (server secret changed). Please enter it again.
emailSettings.testSent: Test email sent to {to}. Check your spam folder too.
emailSettings.saved: Saved. The connection and login to the mail server were checked.
emailSettings.noEncryptionKey: The server is missing a secret key (AUTH_SECRET or SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY), so the password can’t be stored safely.
emailSettings.locked: Locked. Enter your password to change the settings for 10 minutes.
emailSettings.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
emailSettings.fromHint: As recipients see it, e.g. Tourneasy <no-reply@tourneasy.app>. The address must belong to your mail provider.

emailSettings.testHint: Tip: send a test email to the address mail-tester.com gives you; you get a spam score with the reasons.
emailSettings.sendingOn: On: email goes to all players.
emailSettings.sendingOff: Off (test mode): email only goes to admins, organisers and the test addresses below. Everything else is not sent.
emailSettings.sendingAlways: Sign-up confirmations and password resets always go out, because the person asks for them.
emailSettings.allowLabel: Test addresses that still get email in test mode
emailSettings.allowHint: Separated by commas or new lines. At most 50.
emailSettings.paused: Email is off: only admins, organisers and test addresses still get email.
emailSettings.resumed: Email is on again for all players.
emailSettings.allowInvalid: One of the test addresses is not a valid email address.
emailSettings.pausedBanner: Test mode: email to players is off.

Legal.privacyBody: Tourneasy processes your data to make tournament entries, payments and results possible. We only process what is needed: name, contact details, date of birth (for age categories), gender (for events), club and playing level. Data is stored within the EU. You can download your data or delete your account at any time via My account → Privacy. For players under 16 we ask permission from a parent or guardian and show no data publicly. Questions? Contact the organisation.
Legal.termsBody: By creating an account you agree to use Tourneasy to enter and follow badminton tournaments. Entries are final after payment. Withdrawals and refunds follow the policy of the tournament concerned. Organisers are responsible for their tournaments. Misuse of the platform may lead to your account being blocked.

Email.footer: You are receiving this email because you have a Tourneasy account.
